university: Harvard University, Graduate School of Design (GSD)
course_name: Spatial Intelligence: Designing the Future of Work
topics: Intelligent Environments (ethics, social and technical implications)
Machine Learning for spatial factors and work outcomes
Spatial conditions: light, sound, temperature, biophilia, layout
Future of work, AI trends, hybrid work patterns
Surveys and computational tools for design research
license: No license declared; Harvard/GSD website copyright (c) President and Fellows of Harvard College
world_model_relevance: low-medium: 不涉及生成式世界模型，但用传感器多模态数据+ML构建空间条件到人类结果的预测模型，是 human-centered 的弱世界模型视角
spatial_intelligence_relevance: high: 课程核心即 human-centered Spatial Intelligence，覆盖 sensors、multimodal data、intelligent environments、human-space interaction
embodied_ai_relevance: low-medium: 无机器人/3D重建实验，但人-空间交互与环境行为数据与 Embodied AI 的环境理解间接相关
primary_domain: Architecture / Smart Environments / Human-centered Spatial Intelligence
